name: open_question_pilot_arm_a
description: Arm A (control) of the open_question pilot, task 01a0e8b5: the shipped six-way meetings.intent_classify.v1 prompt, scored offline on the pilot dataset. is_question is the projection intent == open_question.
prompt_provenance: Byte-identical copy of the @new_content heredoc in apps/platform/priv/repo/migrations/20260911030000_force_update_intent_classify_prompt_agent_roster_on_unmerged.exs, the LATEST force-update of meetings.intent_classify.v1 (commit f5cc396f), re-copied after task 01a14dce replaced one exemplar line with an invented one. It is copied, not referenced, for the reason priv/intent_eval/configs/off_topic_default.json gives: a run whose prompt source only resolves on some other checkout or database is unattributable. The live prompt_templates row was NOT read. open_question_pilot/prompt_a_drift_test.exs fails if this copy and the migrated row diverge.
agent_roster_provenance: Pinned as data, following priv/intent_eval/configs/agent_roster_20260831.json, and copied from it (the production roster as of 2026-08-31). It is rendered through IntentClassifier.format_agent_roster/1 and handed to the gates as entries, exactly as the classifier does. No live lookup is made, so the run reproduces on any box.
speaker: Speaker
